svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 03 · Davis · 10/12 Orchard Bloom (Common)
svg.desc: Late winter the orchards go white almost overnight, with mustard gold between the rows. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
